newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO PLAYER INJURED IN END-MATCH SCUFFLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO PLAYER INJURED IN END-MATCH SCUFFLE.

text.p: Porto officials accused Milan's Liberian striker George Weah of head-butting defender Jorge Costa at the end a bad-tempered European Champions' League clash on Wednesday and said Costa's nose may have been broken.

Club doctor Jose Carlos Esteves told journalists that Costa, who was shown on television after the game with blood streaming from his nose, would have an x-ray on Thursday to see the extent of the damage.
"Costa was head-butted by Weah and did not have time to defend himself," Esteves said.
Television pictures showed players from Milan and Porto scuffling in the tunnel leading to the dressing-rooms at the end of the game which ended in a 1-1 draw.
The match was littered with fouls and yellow cards.

Porto coach Antonio Oliveira said that the incident had been reported to UEFA officials present at the game in which the Portuguese side assured themselves of finishing top of Group D of the Champions' League phase of the European Cup.

Milan's Oscar Tabarez said that he had seen "a tumult" as the players headed for the dressing-rooms but declined to make any further comment. "It is up to the UEFA officials, they were there," he said.
Milan still need a point from their final match against Norway's Rosenborg to be assured of reaching the quarter-finals of a competition they have won five times.
